# OxY — Portfolio (full documentation)

> Personal portfolio of Sylva: projects, experience, and writing. Systems
> engineering background, AI-infrastructure projects, build-in-public. This is
> the unrestricted form of /llms.txt for agents that want complete detail.

## Who

Sylva — computer-science graduate, systems engineer (Dassault Systèmes),
Île-de-France. Builds PAI (Personal Artificial Intelligence infrastructure):
a Jarvis-class personal agent runtime, the stated mission being a system that
automates low-value tasks so time goes to high-value work.

## Projects featured on this site

- **Alpha Finder** — early-signal tech watch SaaS: continuous ingest of model
  drops, exploding repos/startups, live cyber campaigns; provenance-of-trust
  for every tracked source; retrospective re-scoring of signals. Live at
  [alpha.devprocore.com](https://alpha.devprocore.com) with a public JSON API
  (see its /llms.txt and /openapi.json).
- **PAI** — the personal-AI meta system: canonical docs, entity vault
  (Obsidian as system of record), infrastructure-as-code for the VPS, and the
  Hermes async agent runtime.
- **Growth engine** — distribution layer for the portfolio: GEO citation
  probing, short-form content pipeline, multi-business publishing ops.

## Site structure

- `/` — single page: hero, about, projects, experience, skills, testimonials,
  pricing notes, contact. All content is static and prerendered.
